en.html:
Kanae"Arre, udhar!? HER you are looking at!?"
Sayo"A gentleman's eyes fixed on oneself... what ecstasy. Age may increase; a woman's pleasure in this does not decrease."
Ichijou"Oye, granny! 'Ecstasy'?! That word is above your pay grade! Above your entire department! Apni position toh dekho!"
Kageaki"That is... an aloha shirt. The bright pattern suits you very well."
Sayo"Hohoho. Such sweet words, Mr. Minato."
Kageaki"My actual opinion only..."
Sayo"...I may believe you, you know?"
Kageaki"At your discretion."
Sayo"Naughty behaviour you must not do, young man..."
Kageaki"Naughty is hardly—"
Kanae"O HELLO! You two! Thoda rukoge?! Wait a moment!"
Ichijou"Minato sir, hosh mein aaiye! Heatstroke?! Head boiled?! Brain has become stew, is that the present condition?!"
Kageaki"I do not believe it has."

ja.html:
香奈枝「ってそっち見るのかよ!?」
さよ「殿方の視線を釘付けにするこの快感…… 　女としての悦よろこびは幾歳いくつになっても変わらぬ ものでございます」
一条「待て婆さんいま変な字使わなかったか？ 　変なっつーか分不相応っつーか立場わきま えてねーっつーか！」
景明「それは……アロハシャツですね。 　明るい柄が良くお似合いです」
さよ「ほほほ、お上手ですね。湊斗さまは」
景明「本心から言ったまでの事……」
さよ「……信じてしまいますよ？」
景明「ご随意に」
さよ「やんちゃをなさってはいけません。 　お若い方……」
景明「やんちゃなどと……」
香奈枝「おぉーい！ 　ちょっと待ってよそこの二人ー！」
一条「湊斗さん、正気に戻ってください！ 　熱射病ですかっ!?　頭沸いたんですかっ!? 脳が煮え立ってシチュー状になってたりしま せん!?」
景明「していないと思うが」

en.html:
Kageaki"The Chamberlain's clothing I praised. That is all."
Kanae"It did not sound like that at all..."
Ichijou"Dictionary meaning, fine... But between the lines, sir, between the lines there is a whole ocean..."
Kageaki"Complicated things you are saying."
Sayo"Mr. Minato... this conversation we shall continue later. When it is only the two of us."
Kageaki"Yes."
Ichijou"THERE! WAHI! That gap between the lines, Minato sir!!"
Kanae"Now suppose some strange foreshadowing gets established, and later a strange scene is inserted! Responsibility kaun lega?! Who will take responsibility? Kageaki, you are being careless!"
